newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Soundwill offers 300 mln shrs at HK$2.10-2.30 each.
newsitem.headline: Soundwill offers 300 mln shrs at HK$2.10-2.30 each.

text.p: Property redevelopment concern Soundwill Holdings Ltd said it would offer 300 million shares, or 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, at price ranging from HK$2.10 to HK$2.30 each in a public offer.
The public offer would run from Monday to Thursday. The issue price would be fixed on Thursday. Dealing in the company's shares would begin on March 21, the company said in a statement.
Soundwill said 85 percent of the issue would be placed to professional and institutional investors, and the remaining 15 percent would be offered to the public in Hong Kong.

The public offer portion in Hong Kong would be increased to 20 percent if it was three to six times oversubscribed, to 25 percent if it was six to 10 times oversubscribed, and to 30 percent if it was more than 10 times oversubscribed.
Soundwill also said it had granted an over-allotment option to the underwriters to require the company to issue up to 30 million more shares.
Baring Brothers Ltd is the sponsor, co-ordinator and lead manager of the issue.
Soundwill engages in property investment and redevelopment in Hong Kong, in particular modern office towers and small to medium sized residential buildings.
It said the proceeds would be used to fund its purchase of property, for loan repayment and for working capital.
